name: Taxila
registryBasis: The supplied WUP locator is Taxila, Rawalpindi District, Pakistan. Official Rawalpindi district pages identify an Assistant Commissioner (Taxila), and the Punjab Land Records Authority describes province-wide Arazi Record Centres and land-record services. However, no official source located in this review ties a Taxila-specific Arazi Record Centre or public cadastral service to the supplied settlement point. The Rawalpindi Development Authority Taxila maps are land-use/planning maps, not cadastral parcels. The unestablished local status is null, not evidence that a registry does not exist. The primary PLRA archived printing-procurement index also lists an Arazi Record Center for Tehsil Taxila; its current service state was not verified.

scopeLimits: The WUP point is a population-weighted settlement locator, not a parcel or municipal-boundary assertion. Official Rawalpindi district administration identifies Taxila tehsil administration; PLRA describes Punjab-wide computerized land services but a Taxila-local center could not be confirmed. RDA Taxila maps are planning/land-use products and are not parcel evidence. PULSE advertises indicative property lines and a legal-boundary disclaimer; no geometry request was made because an official safe feature schema and exact point coverage were not verified.
